name: registry.value.delete
description: Delete a single registry value. Use `registry.key.delete` to delete an entire key.

value.description: Value name to delete. Empty string for the (Default) value.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: reg_delete_value
x-implementations.description: Win32 `RegOpenKeyExW(KEY_SET_VALUE)` + `RegDeleteValueW`. Returns ERR not_found when the key or value is missing.

windows-modern.description: RegDeleteValueW. HKLM writes typically require admin; ERR permission_denied without elevation. WoW64 redirection follows the agent's bitness.

windows-classic.description: RegDeleteValueW available since NT 3.1. NT 4 / 9x agents use RegDeleteValueA with ANSI transcoding.
